resources.string: Makes Orba the home screen. Hold Home to open the original TV home.

Makes Orba the TV\'s home screen. Short press on Home: Orba. Long press on Home: original Google TV / Android TV home. When the stock home screen appears on its own (at boot or after closing an app), Orba replaces it. This service only sees the Home key and the active package name; it never reads screen content and records nothing.
